name: Margaret Cavendish (Duchess of Newcastle)
shortBio: English natural philosopher, poet, and dramatist; developed vitalist materialism, arguing that nature is a unified, self-moving, animate, and perceptive material whole in opposition to mechanistic atomism and Cartesian dualism.
centralQuestion: Can organic order, perception, and natural variety be fully explained by an animate, self-moving material continuum without incorporeal minds or lifeless clockwork mechanics?

keyWorks.title: Observations upon Experimental Philosophy
keyWorks.description: Systematic treatise critiquing Royal Society experimentalism, microscopes, and mechanistic atomism, defending vitalist natural philosophy.

keyWorks.title: The Description of a New World, Called the Blazing World
keyWorks.description: Pioneering utopian proto-science-fiction novel exploring natural philosophy, animal-human hybrid societies, and feminine sovereignty.
